name: 25c -Sono Hako wa Shoujo no Himei o Morasanai-
original_name: 25c -その箱は少女の悲鳴を漏らさない-
source:
“...Where the hell am I...?”
My brother Yuki and I were lying unconscious in an unfamiliar room. A square room covered in tiles patterned with what looked like symbols as far as the eye could see. There were no windows in the room, only a door. There's no way I would have come here of my own free will. If that's the case, it can only mean someone forced me here.
“I remember walking around the hospital with Yuki, and then...”
Then—what happened?
I couldn't recall. It was as if that part of my memory had been completely erased.
But something was desperately urging me: ‘Get out of here.’
“Yuki, let's go together. We have to get out of here as soon as possible.”
And so, taking Yuki's hand, I started walking toward the door.
translation:
“……我到底在哪儿……？”

我和祐树失去意识，倒在一个陌生的房间里。那是一间方方正正的屋子，放眼望去，四壁与地面都铺满了印有符号般图案的瓷砖。这里没有窗户，只有一扇门。我绝不可能自愿来到这种地方；既然如此，就只能是有人强行把我带到了这里。

“我记得自己和祐树走在医院里，然后……”

然后发生了什么？
我想不起来。那一段记忆仿佛被人彻底抹去。
可心底有某种东西正拼命催促着我：“快离开这里。”

“祐树，我们一起走。必须尽快离开这里。”

于是，我牵起祐树的手，朝那扇门走去。
